unresolved_gaps: No Inventory entry establishes a Craft storage-engine or database-adapter design.
The WaveDB README reference is branch-relative until the explorer pins the exact commit and source digest.
README claims about MVCC, WAL, atomicity, encryption, performance, bindings, and graph/schema behavior are unverified for Craft use.
No current evidence proves round-trip fidelity between the Craft YAML schema and a hierarchical key layout.
No current evidence resolves whether WaveDB is a non-authoritative projection/cache, an event substrate, or a replacement source of truth.
No crash-recovery, migration, concurrency, stale-snapshot, or rebuild fixture exists for this integration.
The relevant prior Wayfinder/Craft frontier research was found in memory rather than the repository Inventory and must be re-verified from direct source if used.
design_consequences: Use four explorer lanes: WaveDB semantics, canonical Craft contract, adapter/migration failure analysis, and a finite fixture/measurement design.
Require an explicit verdict matrix for three postures: projection/cache only, transactional runtime sidecar with YAML authority, and canonical-store replacement.
Treat .craft/ledger.yml as unchanged authority unless the research proves and separately routes a canonical contract change.
Select exact-binding evidence closure so source claims, Craft row fields, key-path mappings, and fixture obligations remain reproducible.
Keep research artifacts outside public Arcanum; any reusable runtime proposal must pass a later public-boundary and owner-approved implementation route.
non_authority_notice: Inventory is a discovery read model. These matches neither prove WaveDB suitability nor authorize the dispatch, implementation, Craft contract mutation, publication, or promotion.
